All four suspect canaries, `c3-2`, `c4`, and `c4-2`, are still active and eligible for leaks today on Day 5! If just a single canary leaks on Day 6, our suspect pool will shrink drastically. I am very confident, and will refine my approach.\n\n\n**Confirming Recipient Impact**\n\nI'm now realizing a significant implication of a `most_recipients` rule! With \"choose newest\", two canaries give a 62.6% chance of selection. Even with \"default random,\" two new canaries significantly increase the proportion of canary leaks. I'm now weighing the 0.02 cost against the potential to catch the mole sooner and reduce data loss.\n\n\n**Prioritizing Canary Placement**\n\nI'm now laser-focused on designing `c7` and `c7-2` to maximize their impact given today's single regular document.
